notes:
A new logo and a more consistent interface: windows, lists and settings now all behave the same way.

### New
- New Dahu logo on the splash screen, app icon, installer and project files.
- Drag the dividers between the four views to resize them; double-click to restore. View > Reset layout restores the views, the side panel, the command history and window positions at once.
- Settings show changes live while the window is open: Cancel puts back what you had, Done keeps it.

### Improved
- Floating windows open the first time in the middle of the views, then reopen where you left them.
- Command reference and Command history are floating windows; the reference shows an icon and one line per command.
- Every list (layers, blocks, saved views, groups, selection sets, sheets) renames the same way: F2 or double-click, Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel. Extra actions are in the ⋯ menu or on right-click.
- Groups is now a list of groups with their members.
- Settings dialogs share one title bar with a close button; Support information is in About Dahu.
- A click in the views while a menu is open only closes the menu, keeping the selection.
- Shorter texts across the interface; details appear as tooltips.

### Fixed
- F2 in the Blocks list renames the block instead of opening the command history.

---
Windows x64 installer with signed automatic updates and the corresponding AGPL source code. The installer is not Authenticode-signed: on first install choose **More info > Run anyway**.
